fixture_generation._note: 一次性生成命令；测试运行时不编码。fixture 以二进制入库并断言自身 sha256。
fixture_generation.walk-6s.mp4: ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -f lavfi -i "testsrc2=size=1920x1080:rate=24:duration=6" -vf "crop=1280:720:x='640*t/6':y='180'" -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:v libx264 -crf 34 -preset veryslow -g 48 -movflags +faststart walk-6s.mp4
fixture_generation.still-6s.mp4: ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -f lavfi -i "testsrc=size=1280x720:rate=24:duration=6" -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:v libx264 -crf 32 -preset veryslow -g 48 -movflags +faststart still-6s.mp4
fixture_generation.dark-6s.mp4: ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -f lavfi -i "testsrc=size=1280x720:rate=24:duration=6" -vf "eq=brightness=-0.95:saturation=0" -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:v libx264 -crf 34 -preset veryslow -g 48 -movflags +faststart dark-6s.mp4
fixture_generation.short-1s.mp4: ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -f lavfi -i "testsrc2=size=640x360:rate=24:duration=1" -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:v libx264 -crf 34 -preset veryslow -g 24 -movflags +faststart short-1s.mp4
